name: Can I clean up water damage myself to save money?

mainEntity.name: Can I clean up water damage myself to save money?

acceptedAnswer.text: While minor surface spills can be addressed by homeowners, extensive water damage requires professional cleanup. DIY attempts often miss hidden moisture in walls, subfloors, and insulation, leading to mold growth, structural deterioration, and lingering odors that can be more costly to fix later. Professionals use specialized equipment to detect hidden moisture, thoroughly dry the property, and apply proper sanitization. Improper cleanup can void insurance claims or create health hazards, making professional intervention a safer and often more economical choice in the long run.
acceptedAnswer.description: Extensive water damage requires professional cleanup; DIY efforts often miss hidden moisture, leading to mold and greater long-term costs and risks.
